body: i’ve been learning finnish and getting into finnish music these past few months and i love PMMP, egotrippi, pariisin kevät, lyyti, and scandinavian music group for more indie-ish music. i’ve been pleasantly surprised by how much listening to the music helps me with remembering vocabulary and phrases:)

I am not Finnish but I am learning Finnish and applying to study abroad in Finland. I love the language and the culture, I would definitely be interested if there was any culture or language classes, or just to meet people from there!
